lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: A sparse, roughly grid-aligned arrangement of high-luminance circular spots distributed across the visible blue-toned flank; centroids are spaced at approximately regular intervals of 3-4 spot diameters.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Subtle vertical and horizontal linear regions of elevated pixel intensity that intersect to form a faint checkerboard pattern, with high-luminance blobs centered at the intersection nodes.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: A distinct horizontal feature in the lower right quadrant characterized by a sharp luminance shift, transitioning from light pixels on the dorsal aspect to deep shadow on the ventral aspect.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: A circular perforation through the pectoral fin's membrane with a dark, curved, elongated organism or biofouled object anchored through the puncture site.
other_distinctive_markers: Presence of a large, dark C-shaped appendage or parasite attached directly to the trailing edge of the pectoral fin.
